Subject: Re: Invoice submission: portal vs email / sample rows & SLA?

Hi Hanna — thanks for sending this over. Portal is strongly preferred for production (idempotent ingestion, richer metadata, automated ACKs), but we support email fallback for partners that cannot use the portal immediately. Summary / guidance below so you can pick the path that minimizes manual work: 

Portal (preferred):
- Endpoint: vendor portal (link sent via onboarding invite).
- ACK SLA: invoice accepted or rejected within 4 business hours for normal volumes; overnight for large batches during peak.
- Idempotency: portal issues an invoice_token; if the same token is re-submitted we dedupe automatically.
- Required fields: po_number, invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), currency (ISO), line_description, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount (if applicable).
- Optional but recommended: department_code, project_tag, account_subledger.

Email fallback (temporary):
- Send to: invoices@redwood.com with subject: "INV | PO:<PO_NUMBER> | BP" (example: INV | PO:12345 | BP). The PO token is parsed from the subject for routing.
- Attachments: PDF of invoice plus a small CSV for line items if you have many lines.
- ACK SLA: we aim to send a receipt email within 8 business hours for email submissions; longer windows apply over weekends.

Minimal CSV sample (header + two rows) — please mirror column names exactly:
po_number,invoice_number,invoice_date,currency,line_description,quantity,unit_price,tax_amount,department_code
PO-2027-12345,INV-000123,2027-09-01,USD,Consulting - model tuning,10,150.00,0.00,ML-ENG
PO-2027-12345,INV-000123,2027-09-01,USD,Cloud GPU hours,120,2.50,0.00,INFRA

A couple of operational notes:
- If you'll be sending invoices under multiple legal entities, include the billing_entity field in the CSV so our AP mapping picks the right ledger.
- We'll provide a one-time onboarding form link (vendor activation) with credentials for the portal; that form also collects your preferred remit-to details and ACH instructions.

I'll loop Monica (AP) for PO-stamp and multi-entity mapping specifics. If you confirm you'll use the portal, we can schedule a short screen-share to walk the onboarding flow.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hanna — quick follow-up from AP side: 

- PO stamping: we require the PO number to be present on each invoice row. If the vendor portal is used, the PO selector on upload will stamp items automatically. For email submissions, include the PO both in the subject (see Rishi's format) and in the CSV/line fields.
- Multi-entity / legal mapping: add billing_entity to CSV values (legal name exactly as in the onboarding form). This prevents mis-posted invoices and payment delays.
- Provenance / attachments: include the PDF invoice as the first attachment; if there's a supporting CSV for line items, attach as second. That order helps our ingesters link docs to lines.

Attaching a short cheat-sheet (PO-mapping-cheat-sheet.pdf) that shows acceptable billing_entity strings and common department codes we use.

If you go portal-first, we'll flip the ledger mapping the moment you submit the first invoice and confirm it clears validation (usually same day). For email-first, expect the manual routing step which can add 1-2 business days to payment timelines.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
AP Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: PO-mapping-cheat-sheet.pdf (pdf)
